question: Add a new method CompactWithTombstones(ctx context.Context, blocks []BlockMeta, tombstones Tombstones) (ulid.ULID, error) to the Compactor interface in prometheus/tsdb. Compactor is used by Thanos and Mimir for multi-block compaction. All implementations must support tombstone-aware compaction.

files_to_modify.what: Add CompactWithTombstones method to the Compactor interface definition
files_to_modify.why: This is the canonical interface definition at line 54-77. The new method must be added here before the closing brace. The method signature uses BlockMeta (defined in tsdb/block.go:164) and tombstones.Reader (defined in tsdb/tombstones/tombstones.go:62). The import for tombstones package already exists at line 37.
files_to_modify.change: Insert before line 77 (closing brace): `CompactWithTombstones(ctx context.Context, blocks []BlockMeta, tombstones tombstones.Reader) (ulid.ULID, error)`

files_to_modify.why: LeveledCompactor (line 80) is the primary implementation of the Compactor interface in prometheus/tsdb. It already has a context field (line 85) and access to all compaction machinery. The implementation should open the blocks by ULID, load tombstone data, and apply tombstone-aware filtering during merge compaction.
mockCompactorFailing (line 1439) implements the Compactor interface for testing. It already implements Plan, Write, Compact, and CompactOOO. Must add the new method to satisfy the updated interface.
mockCompactorFn (line 9017) implements the Compactor interface for testing. It already implements Plan, Compact, and Write. Must add the new method to satisfy the updated interface.

files_to_modify.what: Add CompactWithTombstones to the Thanos Compactor interface
files_to_modify.why: Thanos defines its own Compactor interface (line 896) that is a subset of tsdb.Compactor (keeps only Compact and CompactWithBlockPopulator, removes Plan and Write). Since the question requires all downstream implementations to support tombstone-aware compaction, this interface must also include the new method.

files_to_modify.what: Update the Group.Compact method to optionally use CompactWithTombstones
files_to_modify.why: Group.Compact (line 913) is the main call site where compaction is orchestrated. If tombstone data is available, it should delegate to CompactWithTombstones instead of the regular Compact path.

downstream_impacts.notes: Thanos uses tsdb.LeveledCompactor as the concrete compactor (created via tsdb.NewLeveledCompactorWithOptions). Since LeveledCompactor will gain the new method, Thanos's usage will automatically get it. The compactv2.Compactor (thanos/pkg/compactv2/compactor.go:46) is a separate struct (not an interface implementor of tsdb.Compactor) so it is not directly affected.

files_to_modify.what: Add CompactWithTombstones to the Mimir Compactor interface
files_to_modify.why: Mimir defines its own Compactor interface (line 224) with Write, Compact, and CompactWithSplitting. The new method must be added to this interface to support tombstone-aware compaction in Mimir's multi-tenant compaction pipeline.

files_to_modify.what: Update runCompactionJob to call CompactWithTombstones when tombstones are present
files_to_modify.why: runCompactionJob (line 251) is the main call site that dispatches between CompactWithSplitting and Compact. A new branch should be added for tombstone-aware compaction.
tsdbCompactorMock (line 1886) implements the Mimir Compactor interface using testify mock. It already has Plan, Write, Compact, and CompactWithSplitting. Must add the new method.

files_to_modify.what: Update the vendored copy of tsdb.Compactor interface
files_to_modify.why: Mimir vendors prometheus/tsdb. The vendored Compactor interface (line 58) must be updated to include the new method, and the vendored LeveledCompactor must include the implementation.

downstream_impacts.notes: Mimir's Compactor interface is independent from tsdb.Compactor but mirrors it. The vendored copy at mimir/vendor/github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/compact.go must also be updated since Mimir's compactor code depends on it.

BlockMeta.description: Struct containing block metadata: ULID, MinTime, MaxTime, Stats, Compaction info, and Version

tombstones.Reader.description: Interface with Get(ref SeriesRef) (Intervals, error), Iter(func(SeriesRef, Intervals) error) error, Total() uint64, and Close() error. This is the existing tombstone abstraction in tsdb, not a new type called 'Tombstones'.

ulid.ULID.description: Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier, used as block IDs throughout tsdb

implementation_notes: The question specifies parameter type 'Tombstones' but the existing tsdb tombstone type is `tombstones.Reader` (an interface). The method signature should use `tombstones.Reader` to be consistent with existing tsdb conventions.

The question specifies `blocks []BlockMeta` but existing Compact methods work with directory paths (`dirs []string`) and open blocks (`[]*Block`). The new method introduces a metadata-based API which is a design departure - blocks would need to be resolved from their metadata.
LeveledCompactor already has a `ctx` field (compact.go:85) which can be used, but the new method takes an explicit context parameter which is the more modern Go pattern.

The existing DB.CleanTombstones() method (db.go) already handles tombstone-based compaction internally by calling compactor.Write() with filtered data. CompactWithTombstones would formalize this as a first-class interface method.
